description: Fabric 4L Contract Deprecation Register. Tracks anti-patterns and their migration to canonical contracts per CONTRACT.md.

items.resolution: No live runtime violations reported by platform contract lint and no-net-new contract violation gates.
items.rationale: Tenant context must flow through request-scoped AsyncLocalStorage, not explicit parameters. Prevents parameter pollution and cross-tenant spoofing.
Only auth middleware should read tenant headers. Downstream code must use validated context.
